mission: As Desh lays the nodes, Ben walks through the forming field and realizes the infrastructure has become legible to him in a way it never was before, while Veraine's design logic reveals itself underfoot.
why_now: The climax needs this sensory lesson before it can rely on it. Ben has to acquire the node-sense here or the next chapter will feel like it invented a new tool mid-crisis.
conflict: Ben is learning something new in the worst possible place to stop and examine it. At the same time, the ground itself tells him he is walking through Veraine's thinking.
turning_point: Ben knows where the next node belongs before he sees it, and Sera's look tells him she knows he felt it too.
opening_hook: Desh is already moving ahead of them on the broken ground, the node-cases slung across his back and his datapad in one hand, setting the first of the nodes at a position he has spec'd down to the centimetre
closing_hook: They reach the mid-valley position. Desh is a hundred metres ahead, setting the sixth node. Ben can feel all six behind him without turning around. Sera's hand brushes his shoulder — not a gesture, a confirmation — and takes her position. Kael takes his. The plan is in place
emotional_trajectory: The approach's deliberate pace -> Desh working at the edge of hearing -> the nodes becoming audible as objects -> Veraine's signature felt underfoot -> the quiet arrival at the mid-valley position with a new capacity Ben does not yet know is new

stakes.personal: Ben acquiring — without announcement, without articulation — a Weave-sensing capacity that will carry the climactic legibility in Ch 25-26; Ben walking through the material thinking of his opponent and registering her as architect, not presence
stakes.interpersonal: Sera's reading the signature and meeting Ben's eyes without speaking — the second wordless exchange between them about Veraine's work (first: Ch 22 mast); the nascent Sera/Kael resonance already forming as an unplanned ambient condition of the approach
stakes.external: The containment nodes being placed and the array taking shape; the climactic environment confirmed as Veraine's design; the plan positioned and ready for s3

setting: Veranthos — mid-approach across the broken ground toward the mid-valley position, nodes being placed in a line ahead of the walking trio
sensory_details: The broken ground underfoot — basalt slabs tilted at angles that do not match any geological process Ben has seen before; Desh ahead with the node-cases, opening them with the economy of someone who has done the procedure on paper four hundred times; each node a matte cylinder the length of a forearm, its base-plate seating with a specific, quiet click when locked into position; the first node passing behind them — and a tone, faint, underneath the wind, in the shape of a held pitch Ben cannot quite name; the second node, a slightly different pitch; the third, a third; the three pitches not combining but sitting at a rhythm; the realisation that he knows where the next position is without looking — the next pitch already audible in the shape of the silence where it will sit; Sera half a pace behind his right shoulder, her own reading moving in parallel, her face the face she wore at the mast; the specific geometry of the node-spacing — not regular, not arbitrary, a logic under it that Ben's hand wants to trace in the air; the Scar visible ahead and below, Veraine's ritual a shape of organised pressure at its base, Torin descending the far ridgeline in peripheral vision; Kael walking at the line's edge, his presence in the Force gradually anchoring at a specific texture as the resonance's pre-conditions form
canon_elements_needed: Sith design-signature theory for Force-amplification architecture (continuity with Ch 22 s2 mast)
Weave-infrastructure sensing — the phenomenon of Force-registerable objects acquiring Weave-presence under adjacent resonance conditions
Non-Force-sensitive node-placement hardware (Desh's engineered containment hardware)
Brotherhood-of-Darkness inheritance conventions (for what Veraine's configuration deviates from)
action_beats: Desh moves ahead across the broken ground and begins setting the first containment node at its spec'd position — the node-case opening, the cylinder locking into its base, the quiet click
Ben, Sera, and Kael begin walking the approach line behind Desh; the first node registers in Ben's Force-sense as a faint held pitch underneath the wind
The second and third nodes pass behind them; the three pitches sit at a rhythm rather than combining; Ben notices that the noticing is new
At the third node, Ben realises — without looking — that he knows where the fourth position will be; Sera's eyes find his, confirm the same reading she is making; neither speaks
Ben feels the array configuration's design signature underfoot — the placement geometry, the inter-node rhythm, the architectural logic continuous with the mast Sera read at Ch 22
The trio reaches the mid-valley position; Desh is ahead, setting the sixth node; Sera's hand brushes Ben's shoulder and she takes her position; Kael takes his; the plan is in place
promises_planted: Ben's Weave-infrastructure-sensing capacity (plants Ch 24 s2; pays the Ch 25-26 climactic legibility of Desh running the guarded route via the nodes' Weave-presence)
promises_paid: Veraine's design-authorship of the climactic environment rendered through the array itself (pays W2 evidence-of-passage architecture beat 5 of 5 — closing the evidence-of-passage arc that began at Ch 17 s3)
notes: This is discovery through movement. Keep Desh real and physical, the nodes felt, and Veraine present only through design.
